items.title: CVS announces plan to split into 2 companies
items.summary: CVS (CVS) plans to spin off roughly 9,000 retail pharmacies into a separate publicly traded company by the first half of 2028.

items.title: CVS Health (CVS) Stock Fair Value Edges Lower On Separation Risk And Analyst Caution
items.summary: The latest analyst work on CVS Health includes a modest trim to fair value, with the estimate moving from US$116.28 to US$113.76 as separation plans are factored into updated models. Recent research leans more cautious on valuation and price targets overall, even as many analysts still highlight potential execution benefits in the health insurance and services businesses. As you read on, you will see how this evolving narrative could shape the way you track CVS Health from here. Stay updated...

items.title: CVS Health’s Future Pharmacy CEO Just Bought $2 Million of Stock
items.summary: Key TakeawaysPrem Shah, who will become CEO of CVS Pharmacy after CVS Health’s planned split, bought $2 million of CVS Health stock on Nov. 6.

items.title: All You Need to Know About CVS Health (CVS) Rating Upgrade to Buy
items.summary: CVS Health (CVS) might move higher on growing optimism about its earnings prospects, which is reflected by its upgrade to a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy).

items.title: 1 of the Largest Corporate Splits in History Is Coming to Wall Street in 2028 -- It's a Stock Up 737% Since Its IPO
items.summary: A large and well-known retail pharmacy giant is planning to split into two companies as part of a new strategic direction.

items.title: Mark Cuban Says the CVS Breakup Is ‘Great for Shareholders.’ Here’s What It Means for a 67-Year-Old Who Bought 1,000 Shares the Day the Aetna Deal Closed
items.summary: Mark Cuban wrote on X that CVS Health's planned 2028 breakup is "great for shareholders" and "changes nothing for patients." On the day it was announced the stock fell 12.5%, about $15 billion of market value. For a retiree holding 1,000 shares since the 2018 Aetna deal, here is what the split does to the position, the $2,660-a-year dividend and the cost basis, and the three numbers CVS has not published yet.

items.title: ‘Don’t Fall for It’: Mark Cuban Says the CVS Breakup Is ‘Great for Shareholders’ but ‘Changes Nothing for Patients’
items.summary: Mark Cuban says CVS’s planned breakup benefits shareholders but does little for patients, urging Congress to pass legislation targeting health care industry monopolies.
